content:
seedo   1
dna     moon blossom
species tutorial tree
mutate  4
# caps 2048 2048 32

# genome: two alleles each, ! marks dominant
gene size     130 130   in 50..200        # scales the whole tree, in percent
gene hue      0! 0      in 0..2           # rotates the purples of trunk and leaves; silver and icy parts never shift; kept narrow so the fade stays purple
gene branches 7 6       in 2..7           # branches up the trunk, one per node, spiralling round
gene low      2 2       in 0..7           # how many of the lowest branches also throw a pair of side shoots
gene seg      8 7       in 3..12          # trunk node length
gene girth    3 3       in 1..6           # trunk width when old; it starts at 2
gene reach    22 20     in 4..30          # length of the lowest branch; higher ones are shorter
gene droop    72 68     in 30..90         # how far the lowest branch leans out from the trunk; higher ones climb
gene curve    -10 -8    in -40..40        # how each branch bends halfway on day 2: up (+) or over (-)
gene fork     32 28     in 10..60         # angle between the two twigs a branch splits into on day 3
gene arc      8 6       in -30..30        # how each later node bends: up (+) or weeping (-)
gene nodes    3 3       in 1..8           # nodes each twig adds after day 3
gene pace     55 50     in 10..60         # tenths of a day between those nodes
gene leaf     6 5       in 2..10          # leaf size
gene green    60 60     in 0..191         # the leaf color when grown: 60 is violet
gene bud      2 2       in 0..6           # size of the glowing buds
gene glow     230 230   in 0..255         # color of the seed and the glowing buds; 192 up never shifts with hue
gene bloom    21 21     in 8..40          # the day blossoms open at the twig tips; 40 never
gene petal    230 230   in 0..255         # blossom color; 192 up never shifts with hue
gene set      3 3       in 1..8           # days from blossom to fruit: the petals fall and an orb appears
gene orb      3 3       in 1..8           # how big a fruit orb swells, a step a day
gene fruit    230 230   in 0..255         # orb color; 192 up never shifts with hue
gene spark    226 226   in 0..255         # the small glowing bead under each orb

angle 20
let fresh = green + 2                  # new leaves start two shades lighter
let tall  = seg + K / 8                # terroir: richer terrain, a slightly taller leader
# day 0: a glowing seed in the dirt
axiom '(glow) O(2) A H

# day 1: a slender leader rises (A is its lower half, H its upper half, drawn one after the other), leaning a little at each node, with a branch bud at each node from the third up.
# each segment's color is set by its height: dark purple at the roots, lighter purples, then silver at the top
A -> '(58) !(2, girth) F(tall + 2) /(40) &(4) '(58) F(tall) '(59) !(2, girth - 0) F(tall - 0) [ B(0 - 9 * (0 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(-4) '(60) !(2, girth - 0) F(tall - 0) [ B(1 - 9 * (1 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(4) '(61) !(2, girth - 1) F(tall - 1) [ B(2 - 9 * (2 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(-4) '(62) !(2, girth - 1) F(tall - 1) [ B(3 - 9 * (3 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(4)
H -> '(63) !(2, girth - 2) F(tall - 2) [ B(4 - 9 * (4 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(-4) '(218) !(2, girth - 2) F(tall - 2) [ B(5 - 9 * (5 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(4) '(219) !(2, girth - 3) F(tall - 3) [ B(6 - 9 * (6 >= branches)) ] /(137) &(-4) '(220) !(1) F(tall / 2) '(glow) O(bud) X(0)
# day 2: every branch springs out at once, starting in the trunk's color where it leaves and turning silver halfway; low ones long and level with a pair of side shoots, high ones short and climbing
B(i) if i >= 0 and i < low -> '((59 + i) * (i < 5) + 218 * (i >= 5)) !(1) &(droop - i * 7) F(reach - i * reach / 9) '(218) [ +(40) ^(10) F(reach / 3) '(glow) O(bud) X(0) ] [ -(40) ^(10) F(reach / 3) '(glow) O(bud) X(0) ] ^(curve) F((reach - i * reach / 9) * 2 / 3) '(glow) O(bud) X(0)
B(i) if i >= low -> '((59 + i) * (i < 5) + 218 * (i >= 5)) !(1) &(droop - i * 7) F(reach - i * reach / 9) '(218) ^(curve) F((reach - i * reach / 9) * 2 / 3) '(glow) O(bud) X(0)
# day 3: every branch and the leader's tip split into two green twigs, each opening a tuft of three leaves
X(a) -> [ +(fork) '(fresh) !(1) F(6) '(fresh, 3) [ +(35) L(leaf) ] [ -(35) L(leaf) ] L(leaf - 1) Y(0) ] [ -(fork) '(fresh) !(1) F(6) '(fresh, 3) [ +(35) L(leaf) ] [ -(35) L(leaf) ] L(leaf - 1) Y(0) ]
# then each twig adds a node every few days, with one leaf, turning so the leaves spiral
Y(k) if k < nodes and g < bloom and g * 10 >= 40 + k * pace -> ^(arc) /(150) '(fresh) F(5) '(fresh, 3) [ +(55) L(leaf) ] Y(k + 1)
# blossoms open at every twig tip: five petals marked 9 so they can fall, and a fruit to come
Y(k) if g >= bloom -> '(petal, 9) L(leaf - 1, 9) /(72) L(leaf - 1, 9) /(72) L(leaf - 1, 9) /(72) L(leaf - 1, 9) /(72) L(leaf - 1, 9) Z(0)
# set days later the petals fall (an empty successor deletes) and the fruit hangs on a short stem below the tip
L(s, p) if p == 9 and g >= bloom + set ->
'(c, p) if p == 9 and g >= bloom + set ->
Z(d) if g >= bloom + set -> T(90) T(48) T(24) T(12) T(6) T(3) '(220) !(1) F(3) '(fruit) O(1, orb) '(spark) f(2) O(1)
# the orb swells one step a day until it reaches orb
O(r, m) if r < m -> O(r + 1, m)
# new leaves darken a shade a day for three days
'(c, m) if m > 0 and m < 4 -> '(c - 1, m - 1)
# the trunk thickens a step every four days toward its girth
!(t, m) if t < m and g % 4 == 0 -> !(t + 1, m)
